recommendation: Use one derive_more2.1.1 direct dependency with display,error features; derive Display+Error for unboxed ValidationScopeError; derive Display only for TextureViewError and retain its small manual Error::source body. assessments.disposition: Derivable exactly with derive_more Display/Error. Native and Progress tuple variants each have one unboxed Error field. Display generator forwards fmt(field,sameformatter); Error inference selects sole tuple field and emits Some(field-as-dyn-Error). This preserves the current immediate source type and native/progress source chain, requires no new From conversion, no Box or error widening.

Alternative #[derive(Debug,thiserror::Error)] with Native(#[source]wgpu::Error) and Progress(#[source]ValidationProgressError), each #[error("{0}")], preserves standard messages/immediate cause. Do not use #[error(transparent)]: exact locked macro calls inner Error::source, skipping the current immediate native/progress layer. No claim a transparent derive preserves current downcasts.

Retain manual body. Current source() explicitly calls cause.as_ref(), so dynamic concrete source is wgpu::Error or ValidationProgressError. Locked thiserror and derive_more source generation calls their AsDynError trait on the bound field. Blanket T:Error implementation accepts Box<ConcreteError>, exposing Box<ConcreteError> as dynamic source; ordinary boxed source derive is not equivalent for source().downcast_ref::<ConcreteError>(). Its own source forwarding may also skip concrete native/progress layer. Neither inspected source attribute accepts an arbitrary source.as_ref() expression: thiserror #[source] is path-only; derive_more supports source selection/optional/not flags, not expression customization.

Mechanical write_str/write! arms are replaceable by derive_more::Display with exact six variant strings. Keep public variant fields, requested format/operation Debug placeholders, Box types and existing manual Error impl unchanged. No Error derive on TextureViewError. No allocation/error conversion added by the displayed derive policy.

assessments.item: Why Progress has a separate source match arm
assessments.disposition: Or-pattern bindings must share one type. Three native variants bind cause:&Box<wgpu::Error>; Progress binds cause:&Box<ValidationProgressError>. Their bodies separately coerce the as_ref result to &(dyn Error+static). Binding both to cause in one or-pattern cannot use that later trait-object coercion to unify the concrete Box types. Separate arm preserves closed typed causes; do not widen them to Box<dyn Error> just to merge it.

Keep manual. Display conditionally appends captured native text; source chooses native if present, otherwise poll. A plain optional-source derive returns None when native absent; static poll source always ignores captured native. This is semantic fallback/priority, not mechanical field selection. into_anyhow intentionally admits actual cause variant, preserving concrete type at generic boundary; no new From blanket/transparent wrapper change recommended.

wgpu::Error and PollError each implement std/core Error and Display; ValidationProgressError also does. Error derives need Error/Debug/Display/static rather than new Send/Sync bounds. Native-only into_anyhow remains gated and unchanged; boxed public TextureViewError storage and wasm compilation surface unchanged by proposal. No new target/backend lifetime/health guarantees claimed.
